hook: Osian ki sookhi baoli mein Sameer ne do kankaal dekhe.
feedback: Solid twist and strong visual structure. To make it score perfect 10s: 1) Enhance the emotional bond in cuts 4-5 so the betrayal/realization stings even more. 2) Ensure Tanya gets at least one direct dialogue line alongside Vicky so both friends feel active before the trap is sprung. 3) Double check cut pacing so line-free image flashes build maximum panic during the skeletons' reveal. LENGTH: about 65s; it must be 40-52s (roughly 80-104 spoken words).
lines: Osian ki sookhi baoli mein Sameer ne do kankaal dekhe.
Par ye darr to teen ghante pehle shuru hua tha…
Raat ke teen baje, Sameer apne sabse achhe dosto ke sath desert ki purani baoli pahuncha.
Vicky aur Tanya har trip par Sameer ke sath rehte the.
Teeno haste hue vlog record kar rahe the.
Gaon walon ne kaha tha… is baoli ke neeche ret sach nigal leti hai.
Dono ne bahar se darwaza lock kar diya.
Sameer ne gusse mein phone torch neeche ghumayi.
Ret mein Vicky ka black jacket aur Tanya ki mustard hoodie wale kankaal pade the.
Dono saalon pehle hi mar chuke the… Sameer ki repressed memory ab jaagi.
Upar se phusphusahat aayi… 'Humein akele darr lag raha tha Sameer.'
Raat ko purani baoli ki seedhiyan mat utarna… ret tumhe kabhi wapas nahi aane degi.
